data.summary: Recorded the preflight adapter pattern decision across 5 experiments (E128-E132). The 'few lines adapter' pattern is strongly supported: 5/5 harness structures produce stdlib-only adapters under 50 lines across 4 serialization formats (two-file, event-stream, JSONL, CSV, YAML). Adapter lines range from ~8 to 37. The prototype phase is complete; the tool can be pointed at arbitrary evaluation harness output with a small per-harness adapter. No further adapter experiments are needed to support the prototype claim. The continuation is to document the findings and consider the prototype complete, with the option to reopen if a 6th harness structure emerges.
